title: LTX 2.5 ComfyUI Worker
description: Run Blackwell-first LTX 2.5 video inference on ComfyUI with persistent /workspace state

input.name: Use Runpod Cached Models
input.description: Prefer files from the endpoint's Hugging Face model cache; missing files use existing assets or downloads

input.name: Persist /workspace
input.description: Store ComfyUI, venv, caches, and downloaded assets on the attached network volume

input.name: Preload Prompt Enhancer
input.description: Also preload the Gemma prompt enhancer used by the bundled workflow

input.name: Hugging Face Token
input.description: Read token with accepted access to the gated LTX 2.5 model

input.name: R2 Artifact Bucket
input.description: Optional Cloudflare R2 bucket for generated images and videos; used when AWS_BUCKET_NAME and BUCKET_NAME are unset

input.name: Cloudflare Account ID
input.description: Cloudflare account ID used to construct the R2 S3 endpoint

input.name: R2 S3 Endpoint Override
input.description: Optional full R2 S3 endpoint, including jurisdiction when required; overrides R2_ACCOUNT_ID

input.name: R2 Access Key ID
input.description: R2 S3 Access Key ID with Object Read & Write access to the artifact bucket

input.name: R2 Secret Access Key
input.description: Matching R2 S3 Secret Access Key; configure as a RunPod secret

input.name: AWS S3 Bucket Name
input.description: Optional AWS S3 bucket for generated artifacts; takes precedence over Cloudflare R2

input.name: AWS S3 Access Key ID
input.description: AWS Access Key ID (if S3 upload is enabled)

input.name: AWS S3 Secret Access Key
input.description: AWS Secret Access Key (if S3 upload is enabled)

input.name: AWS S3 Region
input.description: AWS region for optional S3 artifact uploads

input.name: ComfyUI Log Level
input.description: Log level for ComfyUI (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL)
